notes.title: Patch v0.5
notes.content:
Greetings to all Abstract Grind enjoyers. Huge Update here! 

◘ New upgrade system
Previously players chose their upgrades via single draft tech from a set of 3 upgrades on each level up in a Vampire Survivor-esque manner. That system is now gone. Players get to spend points into a talent trees tied to hero's weapons instead.

◘ New weapon system

Previously main character didn't have a basic attack, and default skill was "Swirling Blades" which was granted on level 0 and was active all the time.
Now hero can manually perform attacks with their weapons, toggling on an auto-attack function or abstain from attacking which will result in "Swirling Blades" becoming active after a short delay and deactivate again as soon as hero attacks again.

◘ Reworked and new skills
Due to changes in core gameplay there were a lot of tweaks to existing skills which moved to talent trees from a single draft pool. Also completely new skills were added for you to try out.

◘ 9 new steam achievements, several new enemies, numerous bugfixes

tags.feature: ◘ New upgrade system
◘ New weapon system
◘ Reworked and new skills
◘ 9 new steam achievements, several new enemies, numerous bugfixes

notes.title: Patch 0.2.9
notes.content:
[b]Gameplay[/b]
New enemies: Inmate, InmateUber, CockGuy, CockGuyUber(fire), Bone(chills on hit), UberBone and Sci-Fi Attack Turrets.
Inmates and turrets launch projectiles that explode when hit ground. 
CockGuyUber is fire property, so it cannot be frozen.
Bones have Double Attack and slow player on hit for 1 second.

[b]Misc[/b]
Floating text appears on player receiving damage or healing.

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
Fixed bug, where players could loose after they win.

notes.title: Patch 2.5.5 Frostbolt
notes.content:
New skill: Frostbolt (Spell | Elemental | Projectile) Base cooldown: 4.65s
Frostbolt is a projectile spell which chills enemies on hit. Every time Frostbolt is casted, you summon an ice cube behind a character, if amount of cubes reaches 2, cubes will launch forward on next Frostbolt cast.
Priest class buff: Grants 1 use of "Guardian Angel", which saves from lava-death once if you happen to fall off.
